d: Indian-American voters helped Donald Trump make significant gains in 2024, but their political preferences are now being closely watched ahead of the 2026 US midterms. Recent polling shows strong Democratic support among Asian Indian voters, with immigration, H-1B fees, jobs, education, the economy and discrimination among the issues shaping voter views. Meanwhile, China’s Alibaba has unveiled its Zhenwu V900 AI chip as Beijing accelerates efforts to reduce reliance on US technology.
